content: EAS Build HealthKit setup: needs com.apple.developer.healthkit and com.apple.developer.healthkit.access in ios.entitlements. NSHealthShareUsageDescription and NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription in Info.plist. Config plugin (@kingstinct/react-native-healthkit) handles this automatically. Known issue: EAS may use stale provisioning profile after capability is added — workaround is to force-regenerate profile or use EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 and manually manage. Default permission strings ('Allow app to check health info') are likely too generic for App Store review — write specific descriptions.
